cs.t: Guacamole is awesome! I highly recommend it. I used Guacamole + a 1st gen Chromebook as my laptop for several years of college work in 2012-2014. Tasks that worked well: - writing code in IntelliJ - editing in Adobe Illustrator - working in the terminal - basic CAD in Sketchup Tasks that I’d wait to do at home on my desktop: - drawing, especially in Photoshop - 3D work in Maya - sound-latency sensitive work like MAX
cs.th: Guacamole – A clientless remote desktop gateway
